title: Oneflow virtual-key control messages
description: Additional WebSocket messages, not a replacement for existing messages. See the virtual-key design for ordering, trusted transport, and lease validation.

token_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the complete UTF-8 bearer token; not a usable bearer token.

expires_at.description: Key expiry in Unix seconds; null means no key expiry, not an unlimited policy lease.

revision.description: Durable globally increasing policy revision. Equal revisions may renew a lease, but must contain identical key policies.

valid_until.description: Absolute Unix deadline, at most issued_at + 300 seconds; never extended from receipt time.

keys.description: Complete non-revoked key set, including expired keys until a revisioned cleanup. Unique key_id values required; omission removes authorization. An empty array denies every key.

PolicyAck.description: Sent only after atomically applying a snapshot. The authenticated control connection identifies the daemon; never implies global propagation.
